name: UK Championship 2017
information: Registration opens on Friday 11th August, 7pm BST. The steps for registration are as follows: * Register for the competition on the left. * Pay the £20 flat fee as instructed through the WCA system. * Once we have confirmed correct payment, we will accept your registration. This fee is non-refundable, as it represents a commitment to attending the competition. There is a competitor limit of 250. As this is the UK Championship, only competitors representing the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.
